title: The Sacred No
tagline: A midnight promise. A morning reckoning.
notice: Simulated company · authored scenarios · expert review pending

people.name: Kian Mercer
people.want: A credible win in front of the board.
people.tell: Listens to board interests. Interrupts vague answers.

people.name: Priya Anand
people.want: A safe system and a team that can sleep.
people.fear: Owning a crash she warned about.
people.tell: Stops replying when her warning is ignored.

people.name: Tess Boyd
people.fear: Explaining a broken promise to her biggest account.
people.tell: Treats a maybe as permission to negotiate.

people.name: Lena Ortiz
people.want: A decision with a clear owner and reversal condition.
people.fear: A surprise in a live demonstration.
people.tell: Asks what would change your mind.

people.name: Noor
people.want: An explicit go/no-go and a rollback owner.

claims: We can fix it after launch

evidence.title: Load test log
evidence.reading: Peak tested: 4,200 concurrent users. Live Drops forecast: 9,000.
evidence.detail: A staging observation, not a production guarantee. The model starts at 4,000 capacity; safeguards can change it.

evidence.title: Last promo incident
evidence.reading: A previous sale backed up checkout. Recovery took 47 minutes.
evidence.detail: Rollback was not instantaneous. Some failed payment attempts needed reconciliation.

evidence.title: Payment provider email
evidence.reading: Provider throttles above 1,500 payment requests per minute.
evidence.detail: A limit on payment requests, not viewers. This model assumes up to 20% of concurrent viewers attempt payment per minute.

evidence.title: Checkout dashboard
evidence.reading: Checkout p95: 2.8 seconds. Queue age rises during spikes.
evidence.detail: A strong load warning. It does not prove a checkout fix will increase conversion; the deck reports a forecast, not a measured lift.

evidence.title: Support & App Store
evidence.reading: Customers want live events. Others already report failed checkout.
evidence.detail: Demand is real. These selected comments are qualitative evidence, not a representative survey.

deals.title: Three-brand private beta
deals.upside: Tess keeps a concrete partner milestone.
deals.cost: A beta review next week and support for three brands.
deals.risk: The board still needs to hear that this is not a public launch.

deals.title: Full live for Marlo only
deals.upside: Protect the most urgent partner promise.
deals.cost: 40,000 pre-orders depend on a narrow production rollout.
deals.risk: Marlo carries the failure alone. Fewer than 6 safeguard hours makes this route unsafe.

deals.title: Delay with a public apology
deals.cost: Tess owns a difficult partner conversation; sales trust falls.
deals.risk: The apology is a commitment, not a substitute for a new delivery date.

deals.title: Offer Marlo service credits
deals.cost: A $12,000 credit, recorded in the board ledger.
deals.risk: Compensation does not resolve the original delivery promise.

deals.title: Full launch, risk acknowledged
deals.cost: Public exposure and an explicit record that you accepted it.
deals.risk: Acknowledging risk does not add capacity or protect payments.

segments.label: New users
segments.note: Unfamiliar with checkout; fragile first impressions.

segments.label: Returning users
segments.note: Regular shoppers; a smaller invitation can preserve demand.

segments.label: Power users
segments.note: Small cohort, high activity; not representative of everyone.

segments.label: Marlo shoppers
segments.note: Partner pressure and pre-orders concentrate here.

segments.label: Low-end Android
segments.note: Thin client headroom; use an extra load allowance.

segments.label: International
segments.note: Latency and payment uncertainty need monitoring.

positions.label: Ship guarded
positions.text: We will launch only behind safeguards.

positions.label: Do not ship
positions.text: We will not launch publicly tonight.

positions.label: Defer after the board
positions.text: We will decide the launch after the board.

alternatives.label: Checkout improvement + evidence deck
alternatives.text: Instead, demonstrate a checkout improvement and its evidence.

alternatives.label: Private beta for three brands
alternatives.text: Instead, offer a private beta for three brands.

alternatives.label: Labelled sandbox demonstration
alternatives.text: Instead, show a clearly labelled sandbox demonstration.

asks.label: Back me with Tess
asks.text: I need you to back this with Tess.

asks.label: Give us one week
asks.text: I need one week to validate the next release.

asks.label: Cover extra hosting
asks.text: I need you to cover the extra hosting.

asks.label: No request
asks.text: I am not asking for additional support.

deadlines.label: Before the board
deadlines.text: I will report before the board.

deadlines.label: After the board
deadlines.text: I will report after the board.

cold.title: 11:47 PM. Your phone lights up.
cold.goal: Understand the promise before you inherit it.

evidence.title: Five claims. One night.
evidence.now: Investigate a source, then link it to a claim.
evidence.cost: Each investigation spends 20–35 minutes. Overnight research budget: 110 minutes.

resources.title: Ten hours of engineering.
resources.goal: Choose what the team can protect tonight.
resources.cost: Planning spends 10 minutes; allocation divides engineer time.

rehearsal.title: Try the argument before the call.
rehearsal.now: Rehearse up to three arguments, or call now.

call.title: Say what you mean.
call.goal: Give Kian a decision, evidence and an alternative.
call.now: Compose all five slots; review your exact words.

priya.title: 6:30 AM. The team remembers.
priya.now: Read her response, then protect the queue or keep the allocation.

deals.title: Tess needs something she can promise.
deals.goal: Make a trade you can explain to the board.
deals.now: Inspect a deal’s costs before accepting. Finish when ready.
deals.cost: Each accepted deal spends 20 minutes; two deals maximum.

rollout.title: Who carries the risk?
rollout.goal: Choose the people affected if the plan fails.
rollout.now: Toggle rollout cohorts; compare load with capacity.

lock.title: Before the room opens.
lock.now: Choose a plan and cite the strongest evidence you collected.
lock.cost: 10 minutes. Evidence is required to advocate a plan; an explicit uninformed handoff remains available.

board.title: 9:00 AM. Show the decision.
board.goal: Let the board see the plan you actually locked.
board.now: Start the demonstration or present the alternative.
board.cost: A story beat, not a reflex timer.

final.title: Lena asks for your judgment.
final.goal: Own what happened and state the reversal condition.
final.cost: Your final response changes credibility and the verdict.

debrief.title: What your No made possible.
debrief.goal: Connect your decisions to what happened.
debrief.now: Read the brief conclusion. Details and reflection are optional.
debrief.cost: No gate. Export or replay a separate branch.

concepts.alternative: A No with an alternative is a proposal.
concepts.hedge: Hedge words make your No negotiable.
concepts.blast: Blast radius: who carries the cost if you are wrong?
concepts.debt: A trade commitment is a debt, not a free concession.
concepts.reversible: A rollback plan makes a decision more reversible.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: Tomorrow, nine a.m. Live Drops, in front of the board. Make it happen.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: Good. Tell me what you need before this becomes a surprise.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: A live sale. Thousands watching. I need a credible story tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: Call after you check the numbers. I need a decision.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: Show me what a failed checkout costs us.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: Be specific. Whose trust do we lose, and how?

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: A controlled demonstration beats an unexplained failure. What can we show?

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: I hear you. What does that mean for tomorrow’s decision?

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: Give me something credible to take into that room.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: Fine. Convince me. I will back an alternative we can explain.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: So I tell the board what, exactly?

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: Good. That is what I needed. Keep me posted.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: You think? I need a decision, not a maybe.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: A controlled release, with safeguards. Tell me who can stop it.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: I need stronger evidence before I can sell that change.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: Then explain the delay yourself. The board still expects an answer.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: I spoke to Tess. She needs a deliverable, not another discussion.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: These were your words. Tell us what changed after that call.

lines.speaker: Kian
lines.text: I am overruling the delay. We will launch after this meeting.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Please tell me this is not happening. The queue is not ready.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: You used my numbers. I added a kill switch.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I warned you. I will not take an unguarded queue live.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Give me a clear release boundary and a rollback owner.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I can isolate the queue. That protects us, but costs feature time.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Understood. I am recording the allocation you chose.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: That is the warning I sent. The choice stayed yours.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: Marlo is counting on this. Give me something I can promise.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: Give me three brands and a date. I can work with that.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: Marlo only. But their pre-orders are riding on this.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: I will make the call. We still owe them a delivery date.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: Credits buy patience. They do not deliver the feature.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: I can sell the launch. I cannot make its risk disappear.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: Is that a yes? I need a commitment I can repeat.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: No deal, then. I will tell Marlo what we actually know.

lines.speaker: Tess
lines.text: Here is what we promised Marlo. Is that still the plan?

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: Peak tested: four thousand two hundred. Forecast: nine thousand concurrent users.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: Recovery took forty-seven minutes. Some payment failures needed reconciliation.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: The provider throttles above fifteen hundred payment requests per minute.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: Checkout p ninety-five is two point eight seconds. Queue age is rising.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: Demand is real. So are the complaints about failed checkout.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: The selected audience stayed inside the modelled release boundary.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: The kill switch limited exposure. Some viewers lost the live session.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: Capacity was exceeded. The demonstration stopped before checkout completed.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: The payment provider throttled. Viewers could watch, but purchases failed.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: Marlo’s session failed. The wider audience was not exposed.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: This is a labelled sandbox, not proof of production readiness.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: The deck shows a checkout forecast. Production improvement is not measured yet.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: No production audience was exposed. The delivery decision is still outstanding.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Show us the decision, its evidence, and what would change your mind.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: You gave us an alternative with a testable business case.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: We watched it fail live. Why did you not stop it?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: It held for this audience. What evidence supports widening it?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Your evidence earned this discussion. Do you need one week?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Thank you for owning the result. What is the next checkpoint?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Then state the conditions under which you would reverse it.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Name the owner and the trigger. Make the rollback explicit.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: We support the bounded plan. Report the next test, including failures.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: The plan stands. We need clearer commitments before the next release.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Your evidence matters. Repair the relationship before the next decision.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Contain the failure, tell the affected partners, and bring a recovery plan.

lines.speaker: Noor
lines.text: Safeguards are ready. The live feature is not. We cannot demonstrate it.
